depicted_variant: Ngalyod sebagai ular pencipta perempuan, menampakkan diri agung di aliran air deras dan hujan tanpa menyalin pola seni sakral.

visual_requirements.description: Satu tubuh ular, satu kepala dengan dua mata, tanpa kaki/tanduk/sayap; bentuk ular dipilih tanpa menggabungkan seluruh tradisi.
Air terjun bergemuruh sebagai suara, hujan/banjir terkait kekuatannya; tanpa petir, aura atau korban.
Air terjun dan tepian berbatu Escarpment Country.

aura: Ngalyod pencipta c16 menjulang sebagai tubuh ular di air terjun yang merupakan suaranya c18; megah dan menggetarkan, bukan jahat c20 (klaim: rainbow-serpent-c18, rainbow-serpent-c11).
artistic_choices: Penampilan ular dan warna sisik cokelat gelap editorial; tidak mengklaim corak anatomi yang tidak diberikan klaim.
Tidak menyalin pola Aborigin sakral, tidak menampilkan manusia/ritual; tradisi Ngalyod dipilih secara eksplisit.
Pelangi alami samar di kabut air mengacu c17; bukan kulit neon atau aura warna.
Pembesaran monumental dalam komposisi leluhur mahakuasa c16; tanpa ukuran angka atau pembanding manusia.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of RAINBOW SERPENT, specifically Ngalyod, the all-powerful female ancestral creator in Kuninjku accounts, treated respectfully.
ANATOMY: ONE great serpentine body, ONE broad snake head, TWO watchful eyes, NO legs, NO horns, NO wings, NO human features; earthy dark brown scales, unmarked by borrowed sacred art patterns. [rainbow-serpent-c16, rainbow-serpent-c17]
MOMENT: rising powerfully through the foreground cascade, coiling around the rushing falls, broad snake head looming over the viewer, water sheeting from her moving body.
POWER: the roar of the waterfall is her voice; monsoon rain and floodwater gather around her, physical torrents overwhelm the rocky river bank. No lightning, no victims. [rainbow-serpent-c18, rainbow-serpent-c11]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle at the riverbank, serpent head and enormous moving coil fill nearly the whole square, only fragments of wet cliffs behind.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm broken shaft of low sunlight through monsoon clouds, deep walnut shadows, heavy rain and natural waterfall spray; a faint NATURAL optical rainbow in the spray behind her, not a glowing body or an energy ribbon. [rainbow-serpent-c17]
SURFACE: tactile wet dark scales, rough sandstone escarpment, foaming water.
SETTING: rushing waterfall in Escarpment Country and stony river bank. [rainbow-serpent-c18]
MOOD: reverent, overwhelming, awe-inspiring creator presence, powerful and splendid rather than evil or monstrous. [rainbow-serpent-c20]
HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least1024px; no text/logo/border/watermark, no extra heads/limbs, no media designs, no copied Aboriginal sacred art motifs, no ritual depictions, no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura/neon/energy ribbons.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: PNG asli dilihat: satu kepala ular, dua mata sesuai perspektif, satu tubuh melingkar tanpa kaki/tanduk/sayap. Kepala dan coil memenuhi bingkai, air terjun membentur tubuh dalam momen kemunculan kuat, pelangi optik samar pada spray c17 dan air terjun sebagai suara c18. Semua tujuh Uji Sangar ya: megah pada thumbnail, bukan lanskap/hewan kecil; tanpa korban, pola seni sakral, aura atau teks. Kesan sakral dijaga c20. Kontak thumbnail asli berukuran200 piksel dilihat ulang bersama13 PNG lane-A; ciri subjek dan kesan sangar/agung tetap terbaca.

root_visual_review.notes: Huge single-headed serpent pouring down a flooding waterfall in rain; no legs, horns or wings, no copied sacred art patterns.
